content.short: EtherMail aims to set the standard for anonymous and encrypted wallet-to-wallet communication.
content.description: EtherMail reimagines email for Web3 by delivering anonymous, encrypted wallet-to-wallet communication. It bridges Web 2.0 and Web 3.0 messaging, giving users ownership, control, and sovereignty over their inboxes. For end users, EtherMail enables fully anonymous P2P messages and rewards for reading relevant content. For companies, it provides a way to deliver rich, targeted information directly to asset holders based on blockchain-synced real-time data.
